answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a jetty against identity bloat by tying network influence to capital rather than ephemeral signatures. Like a falcon tracking prey, the protocol audits balances to ensure that every node pays a yarrow cost of locked assets to participate. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must acquire significant tokens, making Sybil operations economically ruinous as the cost of capital outweighs any marginal benefit from network subversion.
